titulo: Draft one, balled up on the floor
caption:
Draft one, balled up on the floor

Draft one went into a ball and onto the floor. Draft two had a tick on its first line within seconds.

A first draft is allowed to be bad, and throwing it out costs less than polishing it.

For whoever lets the first draft be bad and starts the second.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. At the right a paper page titled draft 1 with five lines. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the page shrinks into a crumpled ball that drops to the floor, while a fresh page titled draft 2 pops up with its first box ticked. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: the first try has to be perfect, to: draft one is allowed to be bad.
